title: Indiana Code Title 5, Article 10.3 (The Public Employees' Retirement Fund)
source_id: IC 5-10.3, read with IC 5-10.2 (Public Retirement and Disability Benefits)
verified_how: Read the register's own 2026 Title 5 data file https://iga.in.gov/ic/2026/Title_5.json in the browser (HTTP 200, 4755 entries): article entry number '5-10.3' name 'ARTICLE 10.3. THE PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT FUND' and article '5-10.2' name 'ARTICLE 10.2. PUBLIC RETIREMENT AND DISABILITY BENEFITS', both year '2026', public true.
notes: State and local public employees (INPRS administers it). Old-age, survivors and disability insurance itself is federal (Social Security Act, 42 U.S.C. ch. 7), so no state statute covers that half of the topic.
